objective: Define versioned target-medium publication/export requirements and acceptance evidence for Book System without duplicating reusable Document System rendering, conversion, validation or artifact-verification implementation.

epub.policy: Use stable Recommendation for production conformance unless an explicit experimental profile authorizes draft testing.

epub_accessibility.recommended_target: latest applicable WCAG 2 Recommendation, normally Level AA where no stricter jurisdiction/distributor requirement overrides
epub_accessibility.policy: Accessibility conformance and accessibility metadata are publication-level evidence; do not infer them from successful EPUB packaging alone.

onix.current_public_profile: ONIX for Books Release 3.1.2, latest revision listed by BIC, Oct 2024
onix.role: supply-chain/distribution metadata projection, not Book System canonical-state authority
onix.applicability: only when distribution/supply-chain metadata is needed

pdf.accessible_pdf_profile: PDF/UA-2 = ISO 14289-2:2024 when an accessible PDF deliverable requires PDF/UA conformance
pdf.print_exchange_profile: PDF/X family = ISO 15930; PDF/X-6 is ISO 15930-9:2020 when the target print/prepress workflow requires that profile
pdf.policy: Do not require PDF/UA or PDF/X universally; bind the profile to the actual target medium, accessibility obligation and print-provider workflow.

docx.policy: Treat DOCX as a target-medium profile with structure, navigation, accessibility and visual review requirements; do not invent a universal Book-System DOCX conformance standard.
docx.accessibility_guidance: Use semantic heading/style structure, alt text for meaningful visuals, accessible links/tables and accessibility checking; automated checking is not sufficient by itself and requires human/visual review for issues it cannot detect.

rules: publication_authorized defaults false and may become true only through separate Book-System/author authority.
Every request binds one exact canonical manuscript version and digest.
A format request does not change canonical manuscript state.
Book System supplies publication semantics; Document System implements format mechanics.

acceptance_law: Proof completion is not export freeze.
Export freeze is not publication authorization.
Any correction that changes artifact bytes creates a new artifact digest and requires the applicable revalidation/reproof loop.
Any correction that changes canonical manuscript text must route upstream through Book System canonical mutation/version rules before a new export request.

book_system_requires: stable EPUB 3.3 conformance unless an explicitly experimental newer profile is selected
EPUB Accessibility 1.1 evidence when accessibility conformance is required or claimed
applicable WCAG-level evidence, normally current WCAG 2 Level AA target unless a governing requirement differs
accessibility metadata and conformance-claim evidence where claimed
proof in representative EPUB reading systems
no silent structural or line editing during proof
PDF/UA-2 only where accessible-PDF requirements call for it
no publication authority inferred from PDF conformance
visual review because automated accessibility checking is not exhaustive
no publication authority inferred from DOCX creation
trim/page/bleed/color/font/image requirements supplied by the actual printer/distributor profile
page-order, blank-page, recto/verso and chapter-start proof where applicable
PDF/X profile only when required by the selected print/prepress workflow
proof correction ledger and deterministic re-render/re-proof
physical or trusted soft-proof acceptance where required by release policy

onix_projection.book_system_owns: semantic product metadata values and their relation to the exact book edition/release
onix_projection.authority_rule: ONIX metadata may describe a book product but does not replace Book System canonical state, provenance or author publication authority.

explicit_non_goals: No universal PDF/UA or PDF/X mandate
No draft EPUB 3.4 or Accessibility 1.2 production-conformance claim without explicit experimental profile
No automatic publication after technical PASS

KEEP: separation of technical PASS from publication authority
ADD_OR_REFINE: explicit Book-System to Document-System ownership boundary
DO_NOT_ADD: duplicate document-generation engines inside Book System
automatic publication authority from exporter success

qualification_effect: Research-verified Book-domain architecture/profile closure only. No Document System implementation, file-format validator, render engine, export artifact, runtime qualification or publication authority is created by this artifact.
